skill.summary: Formats a manuscript into a 6" x 9" Printed Paperback and a Kindle Ebook, generating a cover page, TOC, headers, and an About the Author section.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of format-book-6x9 skill.

- Formats manuscripts into both a 6" x 9" Printed Paperback (PDF or DOCX) and a Kindle Ebook (EPUB).
- Automatically generates a cover page, table of contents, headers, page numbers, and an About the Author section.
- Ensures the paperback meets exact size and typesetting requirements, while the Kindle version uses reflowable text optimized for e-readers.
- Prompts the user if essential information (title, author, About the Author) is missing.
- Outputs cleanly-named files in the user's working directory.
